```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggspatial)   # for scale bar & north arrow
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(tmap)
library(tmaptools)

options(java.parameters = "-Djava.awt.headless=true")
Sys.setenv(JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS = "-Djava.awt.headless=true")
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
ohi <- st_read(here("spatial/ohi_regions/goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) %>%
  filter(location == "marine")

rgn_colors <- c(
  "Region_1" = "#C03729",
  "Region_2" = "#E68C7C",
  "Region_3" = "#FC8F24",
  "Region_4" = "#dcaa38",
  "Region_5" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Region_6" = "#98a25a",
  "Region_7" = "#747428",
  "Region_8" = "#627391",
  "Region_9" = "#8d61a9"
)

rgn_colors <- c(
  "Region_1" = "#C03729",
  "Region_2" = "#E68C7C",
  "Region_3" = "#FC8F24",
  "Region_4" = "#dcaa38",
  "Region_5" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Region_6" = "#98a25a",
  "Region_7" = "#747428",
  "Region_8" = "#627391",
  "Region_9" = "#8d61a9"
)

ohi <- ohi %>%
  mutate(rgn_id = factor(rgn_id, levels = names(rgn_colors)))

mapview::mapview(
  ohi,
  zcol = "rgn_id",
  col.regions = rgn_colors,
  legend = TRUE
)
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
bbox_lcc <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(ohi)) |> st_buffer(20000)

land <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  filter(admin %in% c("Mexico","United States of America")) |>
  st_transform(st_crs(ohi)) |>
  st_crop(st_bbox(bbox_lcc))

states <- ne_states(country = "Mexico", returnclass = "sf") |>
  st_transform(st_crs(ohi))


tmap_mode("plot")

tm <- 
  tm_shape(land) + tm_polygons(col = "#eeeeee", border.col = "#c7c7c7", lwd = 0.3) +
  tm_shape(ohi)  + tm_polygons("id", palette = "viridis", n=9, alpha = 0.7,
                               border.col = "white", lwd = 0.6, title = "OHI Region") +
  tm_shape(states) +                             
    tm_borders(col = "grey80", lwd = 0.5) +      
  
  tm_layout(bg.color = "#cce6ff",      # keep blue water
  frame = TRUE,
  inner.margins = c(0, 0, 0, 0),  # kill the blue rim
  legend.show = FALSE) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", position = c("left","bottom"), size = 2) +
  tm_scale_bar(position = c("left","bottom")) 

tmap_save(tm, here("spatial/images/ohi_goc_regions.pdf"), width = 8, height = 11, units = "in")



library(maptiles)

bbox_wgs <- st_transform(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(ohi)), 4326) |> st_buffer(0.02) # ~a tiny pad

tiles <- get_tiles(
  x        = bbox_wgs,
  provider = "CartoDB.Positron",
  zoom     = 10,       # 7–10 for regional maps; 10–12 for close-ups (bigger file)
  crop     = TRUE
)


## attempt 3

library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(viridisLite)
library(dplyr)


ohi <- st_read(here::here("spatial/ohi_regions/goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) |>
  filter(location == "marine") |>
  st_transform(4326)  # Leaflet needs lon/lat

# Mexico state lines
states_mx <- ne_states(country = "Mexico", returnclass = "sf") |>
  st_transform(4326)

# Color palette (9 distinct)
pal <- colorFactor(viridis(9, option = "C"), domain = as.factor(ohi$id), ordered = FALSE)

m <- leaflet(options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = TRUE, preferCanvas = TRUE)) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, options = providerTileOptions(updateWhenIdle = TRUE)) |>
  # state boundaries under polygons
  addPolylines(data = states_mx, color = "#8a8a8a", weight = 1, opacity = 0.8) |>
  # OHI regions
  addPolygons(
    data = ohi,
    fillColor = ~pal(as.factor(id)),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white", weight = 1, opacity = 1,
    smoothFactor = 0.5,
    # hover highlight
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(color = "#333", weight = 2, bringToFront = TRUE),
    # tooltip label
       ),
    popup = ~sprintf("<b>%s</b><br/>Region ID: %s", htmltools::htmlEscape(lbl), htmltools::htmlEscape(id))
  ) |>
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft", options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE)) |>
  addMiniMap(tiles = providers$CartoDB.Positron, toggleDisplay = TRUE) |>
  addControl(
    html = "<div style='background:rgba(255,255,255,0.9); padding:6px 10px; border-radius:8px; font-weight:600;'>Gulf of California — OHI Marine Regions</div>",
    position = "topleft"
  ) |>
  fitBounds(lng1 = st_bbox(ohi)["xmin"], lat1 = st_bbox(ohi)["ymin"],
            lng2 = st_bbox(ohi)["xmax"], lat2 = st_bbox(ohi)["ymax"])

m
```
